MedicalKnowResult.description_en: The response of the health graph entity property query
MedicalKnowResult.description_zh: 健康图谱实体属性查询的返回结果

messages.description_en: The list of recognized entity property results. An empty array is returned if no entities are recognized
messages.description_zh: 识别到的实体属性结果列表；未识别到实体时返回空数组

items.description_en: The answer result for a health graph entity property
items.description_zh: 一条健康图谱实体属性的回答结果

queryContext.description_en: The query context information, such as the original query content
queryContext.description_zh: 原始查询内容等查询上下文信息

requestId.description_en: The ID of the request, which can be provided for troubleshooting
requestId.description_zh: 本次请求的标识，排查问题时可提供

searchInformation.description_en: The search information for the query, such as the search duration
searchInformation.description_zh: 本次查询的搜索耗时等信息

MedicalKnowledgeInfo.description_en: The entity property information and its source link returned by the health knowledge graph
MedicalKnowledgeInfo.description_zh: 健康图谱返回的一条实体属性信息及其来源链接

content.description_en: The structured text composed of the entity name and its properties
content.description_zh: 实体名称及其属性组成的结构化文本
content.example:
实体：阿莫西林胶囊
- 属性[精确活性成分]：阿莫西林
- 属性[生产剂型]：口服用胶囊

url.description_en: The source link of the entity property content
url.description_zh: 实体属性内容的来源链接

description_en: Queries the knowledge graph of health information
kebab_example: aliyun iqs medical-knowledge --query example-string --type example-string --api-version 2024-11-11 --region cn-hangzhou
name: MedicalKnowledge

parameters.help_en: The medical, drug, disease, or food entity whose properties are to be queried
parameters.help_zh: 要查询属性的医疗、药品、病症或食品实体
parameters.name: query

parameters.help_en:
The entity query type. Valid values:
finding: disease
food: food
medicine: medicine
If this parameter is not specified, the type is automatically identified
parameters.help_zh: 实体查询类型：finding 为病症，food 为食品，medicine 为药品；不传时自动识别
parameters.name: type

schema.description_en: The query results of the health knowledge graph

v1_body_parameters.help_en: The query conditions for the health knowledge graph
v1_body_parameters.name: body
